note: Crop water-use, yield-response, heat and salinity parameters for the in-season yield model (server/services/yield-model.ts). Author: Nitya Prakash Pandey. Retrieved/compiled 2026-09-29.

sources.fao56: Allen, Pereira, Raes & Smith (1998) FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 — Crop evapotranspiration. Table 11 (stage lengths), Table 12 (Kc), Table 22 (rooting depth Zr, depletion fraction p). https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e00.htm
sources.fao33: Doorenbos & Kassam (1979) FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 33 — Yield response to water, Table 24 (stage Ky); restated in Steduto et al. (2012) FAO-66. https://www.fao.org/4/i2800e/i2800e.pdf
sources.cropwat: FAO CROPWAT 8.0 default crop file RICE: Ky 1.00 / 1.09 / 1.32 / 0.50, seasonal 1.10
sources.fao29: Ayers & Westcot (1985) FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 29 rev.1 — Water quality for agriculture, Table 4 (Maas & Hoffman 1977 / Maas 1984 threshold ECe and slope b). https://www.fao.org/4/t0234e/t0234e00.htm
sources.heat: Rice: spikelet sterility above ~35 °C at anthesis (Yoshida 1981; Matsui et al. 2001; Jagadish et al. 2007 J. Exp. Bot. 58:1627). Maize: anthesis-silking sensitivity above ~35 °C (Sánchez et al. 2014 Field Crops Res.). Tomato/vegetables: fruit set fails above ~32 °C (Sato et al. 2006). Wheat: 31 °C at anthesis (Porter & Gawith 1999).
sources.calendars: FAO GIEWS Country Briefs crop calendars (BGD, IND, VNM, PHL, IDN) and USDA FAS IPAD crop calendars; season names follow national statistics (BBS Aman/Boro/Aus, Odisha kharif/rabi, GSO Winter-Spring/Summer-Autumn/Autumn-Winter, PSA wet/dry, BPS MT1/MT2).
sources.irrigation: Irrigated share of rice area: Odisha 33.7 % (ASAG 2023 Table 2.4b); Bangladesh Aman is mostly rain-fed with supplemental irrigation (BBS/BADC ≈ 25 %); Mekong Delta rice ≈ 95 % irrigated (GSO); Central Luzon ≈ 65 % served by NIA/communal systems (PSA/NIA); north-coast Java ≈ 85 % technical irrigation (BPS). Rounded.

assumptionFlags: Values marked 'assumed' are not tabulated by FAO for that crop and are taken from the closest tabulated analogue; they are shown as such in the methodology panel.

soil.note: Total available water ≈ 140 mm per m of root zone (FAO-56 Table 19: loam/silty-clay-loam θFC−θWP ≈ 0.11-0.20)

rice.label: Rice (paddy)
rice.src: FAO-56 Kc 1.05/1.20/0.90-0.60, stages 30/30/60/30 d (Asia, monsoon); CROPWAT rice Ky; FAO-29 rice (paddy) 3.0 dS/m, 12 %/dS/m

maize.label: Maize (grain)
maize.src: FAO-56 Kc 0.30/1.20/0.35, stages 20/35/40/30 d; FAO-33 Ky vegetative 0.4, flowering 1.5, yield formation 0.5, ripening 0.2 (mid-season = flowering + yield formation ≈ 1.3); FAO-29 corn 1.7/12

sugarcane.label: Sugarcane
sugarcane.src: FAO-56 Kc 0.40/1.25/0.75 (stages scaled to a 12-month crop); FAO-33 Ky establishment 0.75, vegetative 0.75, yield formation 0.50, ripening 0.10; FAO-29 sugarcane 1.7/5.9

onion.label: Onion (dry)
onion.src: FAO-56 Kc 0.7/1.05/0.75, stages 15/25/70/40 d; FAO-33 Ky establishment 0.45, vegetative 0.45, yield formation 0.8, ripening 0.3; FAO-29 onion 1.2/16

vegetables.label: Vegetables (tomato analogue)
vegetables.assumed: Mixed vegetables are parameterised with FAO's tomato values (FAO-56 Kc 0.6/1.15/0.80, stages 30/40/40/25 d; FAO-33 Ky vegetative 0.4, flowering 1.1, yield formation 0.8, ripening 0.4; FAO-29 tomato 2.5/9.9)

jute.label: Jute (fibre)
jute.assumed: Jute is not tabulated in FAO-56/33/29: Kc and Ky from the fibre-crop analogue (cotton/kenaf, seasonal Ky ≈ 0.85-1.0); jute tolerates late-season waterlogging once tall (BJRI). ECe threshold 2.0 dS/m as in the platform's crop tolerance table.

coconut.label: Coconut (nuts in shell)
coconut.assumed: Perennial palm: FAO-56 'palm trees' Kc 0.95/1.00/1.00. A year's drought mostly hits nut set 12-30 months later, so the current-year Ky is damped to 0.5 (assumed). Coconut is moderately salt tolerant (Maas 1984: MT) — threshold assumed 4 dS/m.

mango.label: Mango
mango.assumed: Mango is not tabulated in FAO-56: Kc from the tropical-tree analogue (avocado 0.6/0.85/0.75); Ky assumed 0.8 (fruit trees 0.7-1.1, FAO-66); mango is salt sensitive (Maas 1984: S) — threshold assumed 1.5 dS/m.

wheat.label: Wheat
wheat.src: FAO-56 Kc 0.4/1.15/0.25-0.4; FAO-33 Ky spring wheat; FAO-29 wheat 6.0/7.1

potato.label: Potato
potato.src: FAO-56 potato; FAO-33 potato; FAO-29 potato 1.7/12

calendars._note: Sowing/transplanting date (MM-DD) and season length in days. The model picks the season that contains today; otherwise the most recently harvested one (within 120 days); otherwise the next one.

irrigationReliability._note: Share of a crop-water deficit an irrigation source typically meets (canal service is interrupted; tube-wells are farmer-controlled). Assumed, documented.
